METALLURGICAL CERTIFICATION & STANDARDS

The Science of SS316
Marine-Grade Architecture

Not all stainless steel is created equal. Cheap local fabricators often install interior-grade SS202 or SS304 that rusts in monsoons. Discover why Invisible Safety strictly mandates virgin SS316 marine alloy.

Request Metallurgical Test Report Calculate Balcony Cost
CHEMICAL COMPOSITION

Why Molybdenum Makes All The Difference

Understanding the chemistry behind true coastal and high-humidity corrosion resistance.

Alloy Grade Molybdenum (Mo) Content Resistance to Salt & Acid Rain Suitability for Balconies
Invisible Safety SS316 (Marine Grade) 2.0% – 2.5% Mo Immune to chloride & pitting corrosion Optimal (10-Year Rust-Free Life)
SS304 (Food / Indoor Grade) 0% (No Molybdenum) Develops brown tea-staining & pits in 1-2 years Indoor only; unsuitable for coastal balcony air
SS202 (Low-Cost Commercial) 0% (High Manganese substitute) Rapidly oxidizes and rusts in first monsoon Severe Hazard: Cable snapping risk
Metallurgical Rigour

Engineered For Extreme Durability

Every millimeter of our invisible grill system is engineered from marine and aerospace alloys to deliver unyielding fall resistance without degrading over time.

ANATOMY OF SS316 CABLE

Cross-Section Multi-Strand Cable

1

DuPont Pure Nylon Encapsulation

High-grade transparent membrane prevents hand friction, repels moisture and airborne salt, and filters UV light to prevent steel thermal expansion.

2

7×7 High-Tensile Wire Core

49 micro-strands of virgin 316 marine-grade steel tightly wound to achieve 400+ kgf tensile capacity while preserving smooth flexibility.

3

6063-T6 Aerospace Track System

Extruded architectural aluminium profiles treated with 25-micron hard anodization to anchor securely into solid concrete without twisting.

STEEL GRADE
AISI 316 Marine

Contains 2.5% Molybdenum specifically formulated to resist chloride attack and pitting.

TENSILE TOLERANCE
400+ kg Breaking Load

Certified to withstand massive kinetic impact forces without cable deformation.

ANCHORING SYSTEM
M8/M10 Concrete Anchors

Heavy-duty expansion studs seated deep into slab concrete for permanent stability.

OPTICAL CLARITY
98% Open Vista

Allows complete daylight immersion and unhindered skyline vistas from all room angles.

HARDWARE ANATOMY

Precision Track & Anchorage System

A cable is only as dependable as the anchoring tracks holding it under tension.

6063-T6 Structural Aluminium

Extruded from architectural grade aluminum-magnesium-silicon alloy, heat treated to T6 temper for high tensile yield strength and zero warping under continuous cable tension.

Hard Anodized Protective Finish

25-micron electrochemical oxide coat prevents aluminum oxidation, matching the subtle architectural hues of modern balcony frames.

Concealed Locking Track Cover

A snap-fit aesthetic cover completely conceals anchor screw heads and tension barrels, shielding internal components from rainwater and dust accumulation.

COMMON QUESTIONS

Installation & Materials FAQ

Straightforward, practical information about invisible grill installation, balcony safety, and building society approvals.

How long does installation take, and what is the process? +
A standard apartment balcony (up to 150-250 sq ft) takes approximately 3 to 5 hours to install. Our 4-step workflow: 1) Free site laser measurement and sample demonstration, 2) Same-day transparent quote, 3) Precision installation by harness-equipped technicians, 4) Digital tension verification, client sign-off, and warranty certificate issuance.
What safety equipment do your technicians use during high-rise installations? +
Our technicians strictly follow Indian Work-At-Height safety regulations. Every technician wears an IS 3521-certified full-body harness secured by a dual-lanyard lifeline system anchored to structural load points, along with safety helmets, non-slip footwear, and tool tethers to prevent dropped objects.
